{{Quote|Are you on Malastare for business or pleasure?|Unidentified Hostess|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
A dark-haired '''human''' with big blue eyes, she was attached in some way to the Eriaduan consulate on Malastare — host of the gala at which the Dug winners of the Vinta Harvest Classic were being feted. She got drunk and flirted with, at the time, Ambassador, Palpatine.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Personality and traits==
Flirty and gossipy, she invited Palpatine to her bedroom while drunk.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
